files.description: This file defines a parser factory that selects the appropriate parser module based on the file descriptor provided by the scanner and returns a list of extracted import strings. It is designed to handle various programming languages by mapping language tags to their corresponding parser modules, ensuring a deterministic parsing process without reliance on machine learning models.
files.role_in_system: It serves as a central point for determining which parser to use for different programming languages, facilitating the parsing process in the broader application. By abstracting the parser selection logic, it allows for easy extension and maintenance of the parsing capabilities for new languages.
